scope: Review of 12 published self-hostable apps currently marked with source_model unknown. Product identity and available official license statements were checked. No production changes made.

records.product_identity: Unraid plugin that adds the 45Drives disk map to Unraid's Main page and generates disk and server metadata on the Unraid host.
evidence_notes: The project README identifies the Unraid plugin and provides its stable .plg installation URL.
The repository file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms.
unresolved: No project license terms were verified; a public repository alone does not establish open_source or closed_source.

records.product_identity: Self-hosted AI photo tool that uses local vision models through Ollama to describe, tag, rename, and search photos.
evidence_notes: The project README identifies the app, its Ollama requirement, Docker Compose setup, and Unraid installation instructions.
The repository file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms.
unresolved: No license terms for A-Eye itself were verified; do not infer its license from Ollama or other dependencies.

records.product_identity: Official Autoscan trigger that listens for changes in Google Drive Shared Drives using a service account.
evidence_notes: The A-Train README explicitly says A-Train has a permissible open-source license and invites forks, so source_model can be open_source.
The maintainer does not name A-Train's exact license in the inspected README; no LICENSE file was visible in the repository root listing.
The README describes A-Train as the official Autoscan Google Drive trigger and documents its Docker image, binary, and source installation.
unresolved: The exact license name and SPDX identifier remain unverified; keep license null and license_type unknown until confirmed from A-Train's own license metadata or maintainer.

records.product_identity: Community-maintained combined container and Compose setup for AdGuard Home, Unbound, and Redis.
evidence_notes: The project README describes a single container combining AdGuard Home, Unbound, and Redis and provides its Compose setup.
The repository file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms for this combined project. The components' licenses cannot be assigned to this wrapper as a whole.
unresolved: No license terms for the combined project were verified; component licenses do not settle the wrapper's source model.

records.product_identity: Lightweight container that periodically updates multiple Namecheap Dynamic DNS records.

current.license: No license declared in the repository

evidence_notes: The README identifies the app, its environment variables, and its Docker image and says it can be deployed through Unraid Community Applications.
The repository root has no license file or stated license terms. The current 'No license declared in the repository' text should not be stored as if it were a license name.
unresolved: No license terms were verified; retain source_model unknown and store license as null rather than as a descriptive sentence.

records.product_identity: Self-hosted homepage for navigating self-hosted apps, bookmarks, and other widgets.
evidence_notes: The project README identifies Oak as a homepage for self-hosters and documents its Docker image and persistent SQLite storage.
The repository root file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms.
unresolved: No license terms for Oak itself were verified; inspiration from Flame or SUI does not determine Oak's license.

records.product_identity: The Tor Project's Docker image and Compose deployment for operating an obfs4 Tor bridge.
evidence_notes: Tor's official docs and Docker Hub identify the image and document Docker deployment for an obfs4 bridge.
The official GitLab project and license file could not be inspected in this review. Licenses of Tor or obfs4 components do not establish the wrapper project's license.
unresolved: The project's own license terms remain unverified because its official GitLab files were not accessible to inspect.

records.product_identity: P3R LEMP Stack is described as a Debian container preloaded with NGINX, MariaDB, and PHP 7.3.
evidence_notes: The Unraid Community Apps entry describes P3R LEMP Stack as an all-in-one container with Debian, NGINX, MariaDB, and PHP 7.3.

The P3R-CO repository README describes P3R LEMP as a single-container stack, but the row has no source_code_url and the exact ownership relationship to the catalog publisher capt.asic was not confirmed.
No app source license terms were verified. Licenses of Debian, NGINX, MariaDB, and PHP do not establish the license of the assembled container or its configuration.
unresolved: Confirm whether P3R-CO/unraid is the source repository for this exact capt.asic catalog entry.
No license terms for the app or assembled container were verified.

records.product_identity: Discord bot that sends status notifications for qBittorrent torrents.
evidence_notes: The project README identifies the Discord and qBittorrent notification bot and documents Docker and Python setup.
The repository root file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms.
unresolved: No license terms were verified; do not infer open_source from the public repository or available Docker image.

records.product_identity: Shell script and Docker container that sets qBittorrent's listening port from a text file.
evidence_notes: The project page identifies the tool and documents Docker Compose use.
The repository file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms.
unresolved: No license terms were verified; the Docker image and public source repository do not establish a source model by themselves.

evidence_notes: The project README identifies a Prometheus exporter for qBittorrent and documents Docker usage.
The repository root file listing, README, and inspected Gradle manifest show no license file or explicit project license terms.
unresolved: No license terms were verified; do not infer the project's model from its public source or container image.

records.product_identity: Docker container that backs up one or more mounted folders to S3 using the AWS CLI sync command.
evidence_notes: The project README identifies the S3 backup purpose, use of AWS CLI sync, and its Docker setup.
The repository root file listing and README show no license file or explicit license terms. Its upstream container and AWS CLI license do not determine this wrapper's license.
unresolved: No license terms for this wrapper were verified; keep source_model unknown until the publisher's license is available.
